title: Managed Database: official incident recording
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database official incident recording applies to database incident. Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident close time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report. No customer statement substitutes for the report. Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage service credits excludes them. Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.
